# opwan_dns (Data Source)

The opdns DNS opt-in and the opdns profiles to pick from.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opwan_dns" "this" {}

output "dns_profiles" {
  value = data.opwan_dns.this.profiles
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `available` (Boolean) This server offers opdns DNS.
- `error` (String) The last problem, in plain words. Null: none.
- `linked_ips` (List of String) The addresses opdns has linked to the profile now.
- `opdns_account` (Boolean) The op account has an opdns account; null when opdns couldn't be asked just now.
- `profile` (Attributes) The profile picked, null while opdns DNS is off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profile))
- `profiles` (Attributes List) The opdns profiles to pick from, empty without an opdns account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles))
- `resolver` (String) opdns's resolver address.
- `state` (String) `off`, `pending`, `linked` or `error`.

<a id="nestedatt--profile"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profile`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The profile id, for `opwan_dns.profile_id`.
- `name` (String) The profile's name.


<a id="nestedatt--profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The profile id, for `opwan_dns.profile_id`.
- `name` (String) The profile's name.
